title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG ASTOUNDS PASSEPARTOUT, HIS SERVANT
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg stuns Passepartout by announcing their immediate departure to travel around the world in eighty days, boarding a train that very evening.
summary_detail: Returning home earlier than usual, Phileas Fogg shocks his new servant, Passepartout, with the news that they are leaving for a journey around the world. Packing only a carpet-bag containing twenty thousand pounds, they rush to Charing Cross station. After Fogg gives his whist winnings to a beggar and bids his Reform Club friends farewell, the two depart by train.
